description: CFG-306: EnvSource client-group prefix is configurable (default OIDC_); a custom prefix maps the client group and the default prefix is not consulted

cases.note: default prefix OIDC_ maps the client group
custom prefix ACME_ maps the client group; the identically-suffixed default-prefixed var OIDC_CLIENT_ID is a different env name and is not consulted

note: The client-group prefix is an EnvSource configuration (config.md §Sources): only client-group environment names take the prefix. When a custom prefix is set, the default-prefixed OIDC_CLIENT_ID is an unrelated env name — the resolved client.id is 'acme-prefixed', proving 'should-be-ignored' was never read.
